lines.en: label secondbeach5:
scene beachpartyyay1
: Uhh...Tsuneyo? Are you sure you’re okay in there?
lines.zh: ：呃……Tsuneyo？你在里面真的没事吗？

lines.en: : I no longer require a flotation device when in water below my shoulders.
lines.zh: ：在水深不及我肩膀的地方，我已不再需要漂浮装置。

lines.en: : I will survive this event and, as the guardian says, “level up.”
lines.zh: ：我会在这次事件中活下来，并且如守护者所言，「升级」。

lines.en: : I...think she means because of how cold it is.
lines.zh: ：我……想她是说因为水太冷了。

lines.en: : Please talk louder, Strawberry Leg Princess. I am unable to hear you from the middle of the ocean.
lines.zh: ：请说大声点，草莓腿公主。我在大海正中央，听不见你说话。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay2
: How come Tsuneyo is always bringing up your legs, Ami?
lines.zh: ：Tsuneyo 怎么老是提起你的腿啊，Ami？

lines.en: : I honestly don’t know.
lines.zh: ：我是真不知道。

lines.en: : At first I thought it was flattering, but at this point it’s starting to get a little weird.
lines.zh: ：一开始我还觉得是在夸我，可到现在就有点怪了。

lines.en: : You’re not going to compliment my legs as well...are you, Karin?
lines.zh: ：你不会也要夸我的腿吧……Karin？

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay3
: O-Of course not! I was just going to say...shouldn’t we maybe...{i}not{/i} let Tsuneyo stay in the water for that long? She’s going to get sick.
lines.zh: ：当……当然不是！我只是想说……我们是不是该……{i}别{/i}让 Tsuneyo 在水里待那么久？她会生病的。

lines.en: : Also, you really do have nice legs.
lines.zh: ：还有，你的腿确实很好看。

lines.en: : Eh. We’re probably all going to get sick after this weekend anyway.
lines.zh: ：唉。反正这个周末过完，我们大概都要生病了。

lines.en: : Also, thank you.
lines.zh: ：还有，谢谢。

lines.en: : I think we kind of all accepted that sickness might be a result of this whole swimsuits in winter thing.
lines.zh: ：我觉得大家心里多少都接受了，生病可能是「冬天穿泳衣」这整件事的后果。

lines.en: : But hey, if Tsuneyo is gonna be brave enough to hop in, I think we should too.
lines.zh: ：不过话说回来，要是 Tsuneyo 都敢跳下去，我觉得我们也该跳。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay4
: Ayane, didn’t you {i}just{/i} recover from being sick?
lines.zh: ：Ayane，你不是{i}刚{/i}病好吗？

lines.en: : I was sick with misery and loss! It’s nothing like having a cold.
lines.zh: ：我得的是痛苦与失落！跟感冒完全不是一回事。

lines.en: : No...What you had sounds much worse.
lines.zh: ：不……你说的那个听起来严重多了。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay1
: Tsuneyo! On a scale of one to ten, how cold would you say the water is?!
lines.zh: ：Tsuneyo！一到十的话，你觉得水有多冷？！

lines.en: : Cold, but not too cold.
lines.zh: ：冷，但不太冷。

lines.en: : The scale, Tsuneyo! Remember the scale!
lines.zh: ：是打分，Tsuneyo！记得打分！

lines.en: : What a rude way to tell someone to lose weight.
lines.zh: ：用这么粗鲁的方式叫别人减肥。

lines.en: : She means rate it on a-
lines.zh: ：她是说按——

lines.en: : Save your breath, Karin. If Tsuneyo doesn’t understand something right away, there’s only one person who is able to teach her...and {i}she’s{/i} off practicing her stealth now.
lines.zh: ：省省吧，Karin。要是 Tsuneyo 没能立刻理解某件事，能教她的只有一个人……而{i}她{/i}这会儿正跑去练潜行呢。

lines.en: : Fuck you in the insulting way and not the sexual one, bro.
lines.zh: ：去你的，是侮辱的那种去你的，不是性意味的那种，老铁。

lines.en: : I am a strong independent noodle who needs no broth.
lines.zh: ：我是一根坚强独立的面条，不需要高汤。

lines.en: : The world is my soup bowl and I’m here to party.
lines.zh: ：世界就是我的汤碗，而我是来开派对的。

lines.en: : Maybe we really {i}should{/i} just swallow our pride and run in after all?
lines.zh: ：也许我们真{i}该{/i}放下自尊，直接冲进去了？

lines.en: : Cowards. You will never survive in the-
lines.zh: ：懦夫。你们永远没法在——

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay5
: Hm?
: Caw.
scene beachpartyyay6
: Ah!
: My son! You have decided to come to the beach!
lines.zh: ：我的儿子！你居然决定来海滩了！

lines.en: : If only your father had never abandoned us and was here to see this!
lines.zh: ：要是你父亲没有抛弃我们、能在这儿看到这一幕就好了！

lines.en: : Caw :(
scene beachpartyyay7
: I shouldn’t. It would be far too dangerous.
lines.zh: ：我不该这么做。那太危险了。

lines.en: : Caw. Caw caw caw. Caw caw caw?
lines.zh: ：嘎。嘎嘎嘎。嘎嘎嘎？

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay8
: Can a simple chemical like bleach truly do something so impressive?
lines.zh: ：像漂白剂这么简单的化学品，真能做出这么了不起的事吗？

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay9
: That’s-
lines.zh: ：那是——

lines.en: : What’s she talking to? I can’t really see.
lines.zh: ：她在跟什么说话？我看不太清。

lines.en: : How did the dorm bird make it all the way to the beach?!
lines.zh: ：宿舍那只鸟是怎么一路跑到海滩来的？！

lines.en: : Chickens always come home to roost, Ami.
lines.zh: ：鸡总是要回窝的，Ami。

lines.en: : And I guess sparrows, too.
lines.zh: ：我看麻雀也是。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay10
: You guys have a dorm bird?! I want a dorm bird!
lines.zh: ：你们有宿舍鸟？！我也想要一只宿舍鸟！

lines.en: : Living at home sucks! I wanna go back a year!
lines.zh: ：住家里太烂了！我想回到一年前！

lines.en: : No, Karin. No...
lines.zh: ：不，Karin。别……

lines.en: : There’s something...special about that bird.
lines.zh: ：那只鸟……有点特别。

lines.en: : He’s...up to something.
lines.zh: ：他……在搞什么名堂。

lines.en: : I think he’s just a bird, Ami.
lines.zh: ：我觉得他就是只鸟而已，Ami。

lines.en: scene black
{i}Meanwhile, several feet behind them under a gazebo pavilion thing...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时，在她们身后几英尺、某个凉亭棚子下面……{/i}

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay11
: I can do this. I can do this. I can do this. I can do this. I can do this. I can do this. I can do this. I can do this. I can do this.
lines.zh: ：我能行。我能行。我能行。我能行。我能行。我能行。我能行。我能行。我能行。

lines.en: : Futaba, tell me I can do this.
lines.zh: ：Futaba，你说我能行。

lines.en: : You can do this...
lines.zh: ：你能行的……

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay12
: Oh my god. I can’t do it and I’m gonna die.
lines.zh: ：天啊。我做不到，我要死了。

lines.en: : I’m gonna die and everyone’s gonna remember me as that girl who died from being too bisexual.
lines.zh: ：我要死了，而且大家会永远记得我是那个因为太双性恋而死掉的女生。

lines.en: : You’re not going to die...you just need to calm down a little.
lines.zh: ：你不会死的……你只需要稍微冷静一点。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay13
: You have experience now, remember?
lines.zh: ：你现在有经验了，记得吗？

lines.en: : It won’t be your first confession this time, so I imagine you’ll be a little better at talking.
lines.zh: ：这次不是你第一次告白了，所以我想你会说得好一点。

lines.en: : You are putting way too much faith in my ability to make it through a sentence around a girl I wanna kiss.
lines.zh: ：你也太看得起我了，我可是连在想亲的女生面前说完一句话都费劲。

lines.en: : Maybe so. But also, you’ve been hanging out with Otoha a lot more than normal lately.
lines.zh: ：也许吧。不过还有一点，你最近跟 Otoha 玩的时间比平时多很多。

lines.en: : Back when you confessed to Chika, you two had only just started hanging out.
lines.zh: ：你向 Chika 告白那会儿，你们俩才刚开始一起玩。

lines.en: : Don’t you think that has to be some sort of sign?
lines.zh: ：你就不觉得这算是某种信号吗？

lines.en: : If someone you knew liked you and kept trying to hang out with you all the time, what would you do?
lines.zh: ：要是你认识的一个人喜欢你，还一直想跟你待在一起，你会怎么做？

lines.en: : Height? Weight? Favorite band? Hair color? Do they like girls?
lines.zh: ：身高？体重？最喜欢的乐队？发色？她们喜欢女生吗？

lines.en: : Wait, no. They obviously like girls if they like me.
lines.zh: ：等等，不对。她们要是喜欢我，那显然就是喜欢女生。

lines.en: : Unless they think I’m a boy-
lines.zh: ：除非她们以为我是男生——

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay14
: Oh God! What if Otoha thinks I’m a boy?!
lines.zh: ：天啊！要是 Otoha 以为我是男生怎么办？！

lines.en: : I am...positive Otoha is well aware that you are a girl, Rin...
lines.zh: ：我……很确定 Otoha 清楚你是女生，Rin……

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay15
: Just stay confident...tell her how you feel...and be ready to accept whatever comes next.
lines.zh: ：保持自信……告诉她你的感受……然后准备好接受接下来的一切。

lines.en: : What...I would probably do if I was ever going to...confess like this, is plan out a reaction for both a good and a bad outcome beforehand.
lines.zh: ：换作是我，如果真要这样……告白的话，我会事先把好结果和坏结果的反应都想好。

lines.en: : That way, I’d be ready to react no matter what happens and wouldn’t get blindsided by a surprise answer.
lines.zh: ：那样的话，不管发生什么我都能应对，不会被一个意外的答案打个措手不及。

lines.en: : And...given what you’re going to be asking her, I can’t really see how a...surprise answer would even happen.
lines.zh: ：而且……考虑到你要问她的是什么，我真看不出怎么会……出现意外的答案。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay16
: Man...how come you’re so good with all of this romance stuff all of a sudden?
lines.zh: ：天啊……你怎么突然这么懂恋爱这些事了？

lines.en: : The Futaba from last year took all of her love tips straight out of medieval fantasy novels.
lines.zh: ：去年的 Futaba 还把所有恋爱建议都从中世纪奇幻小说里照搬呢。

lines.en: : Now you’re out here talking like some seasoned mother who’s popped out five kids with a sixth on the way.
lines.zh: ：现在你说话的样子，活像个生过五个、还怀着第六个的老练母亲。

lines.en: : And I’m your adopted daughter struggling with her sexual identity and spending way too long in the shower cause we’ve got one of those detachable hose thingies.
lines.zh: ：而我是你那个正在纠结性取向、还因为家里装了可拆卸花洒而在浴室里待太久的养女。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay17
: Uhh...No, Rin. I’m talking like your best friend and number one support system.
lines.zh: ：呃……不是，Rin。我是在以你最好的朋友、头号后援团团长的身份说话。

lines.en: : Also, please leave your shower habits to yourself.
lines.zh: ：还有，你洗澡的习惯请自己留着。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. We all do it.
lines.zh: ：拜托。谁都会啦。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay18
: It...It doesn’t matter what we do! What matters is that you don’t let yourself get distracted right now and figure out how and when you’re going to confess.
lines.zh: ：我……我们做什么不重要！重要的是你现在别分心，想好你要怎么告白、什么时候告白。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay19
: Umm...Futaba?
lines.zh: ：嗯……Futaba？

lines.en: : Yes?
lines.zh: ：怎么？

lines.en: : I really love you, you know.
lines.zh: ：我真的很爱你，你知道的。

lines.en: : Like, not in a shower head kind of way. A sister kind of way.
lines.zh: ：就是，不是花洒的那种爱。是姐妹的那种。

lines.en: : Thank you for clarifying. I love you in a non-shower head way as well.
lines.zh: ：谢谢你的澄清。我也用非花洒的方式爱你。

lines.en: : And Sensei is also just around the corner...probably.
lines.zh: ：而且 Sensei 大概也就在拐角那边……大概吧。

lines.en: : Yeah...I already gave him the heads up about what’s gonna wind up happening this weekend.
lines.zh: ：嗯……我已经提前跟他说过这个周末会发生什么了。

lines.en: : I am more than prepared to spend the coming days crying into both of you, so maybe us three should just get a room to ourselves?
lines.zh: ：我已经完全准备好接下来几天抱着你们俩哭了，所以要不我们三个干脆自己开间房？

lines.en: : Can you ask your parents for an advance on your allowance? I asked my mom for concert tickets last week, so I’m kinda in the no fly zone for a little while.
lines.zh: ：你能不能跟你爸妈预支点零花钱？我上周刚跟我妈要了演唱会的票钱，所以短期内有点进不了「可飞区」。

lines.en: : I’m...pretty sure Touka’s family rented out the entire inn, so there will be more than enough places for you to cry.
lines.zh: ：我……挺确定 Touka 家把整间旅馆都包下来了，所以够你哭的地方多的是。

lines.en: : For now, though...let’s just hope that you won’t be crying at all.
lines.zh: ：不过现在嘛……我们就盼着你根本不会哭吧。

lines.en: : Now...tell me more about when you’re going to do it.
lines.zh: ：好了……再跟我说说你打算什么时候动手。

lines.en: scene black
{i}Meanwhile, yet again, even further along the beach.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时，再一次，在海滩更远一点的地方。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But not that far.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但也没远到哪儿去。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Just...kinda...over there or something.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}就是……大概……在那边的样子。{/i}

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay20
: You plannin’ on swimmin’ at all, Sana? Or are you gonna be like me and just wear the swimsuit for show but not bother gettin’ your feet wet?
lines.zh: ：你打算下水游吗，Sana？还是跟我一样，就穿着泳衣做做样子，脚都不沾水？

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay21
: I’m...not really good at swimming.
lines.zh: ：我……不太会游泳。

lines.en: : And the ocean is kind of big, so...I’ll probably just stay here...
lines.zh: ：而且大海挺大的，所以……我大概就待在这儿吧……

lines.en: : Looks like it’s gonna be you and me then since Makoto’s still back at the room layin’ out futons and stuff.
lines.zh: ：看来就剩你和我了，Makoto 还在房间里铺被褥什么的呢。

lines.en: : Did ya hear that Nodoka basically [molest]ed us?
lines.zh: ：你听说了吗，Nodoka 基本上把我们都[molest]了。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay22
: She...what?
lines.zh: ：她……什么？

lines.en: : Are you okay?
lines.zh: ：你还好吗？

lines.en: : Uhhh, sorry. Probably not the best choice of words.
lines.zh: ：呃，抱歉。这词用得大概不太合适。

lines.en: : Just kinda a light hearted strip search thingy. Didn’t actually touch any of the goods if ya know what I mean.
lines.zh: ：就是那种轻松的脱衣搜查罢了。你要懂的话，其实没真碰到什么「要害」。

lines.en: : I should've cleared that up before scarin’ ya.
lines.zh: ：我该先说清楚的，免得吓着你。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay23
: Oh.
: No...I’m sorry for...not understanding that right away...
lines.zh: ：不……抱歉……我没能马上明白……

lines.en: : Nodoka is...a nice girl and...probably wouldn’t ever do anything like that.
lines.zh: ：Nodoka 是……个好女孩，而且……大概永远不会做那种事。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Hey, everythin’ okay? You’re lookin’ a little under the weather.
lines.zh: ：嘿，你还好吗？你看起来有点不太舒服。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay24
: Hm?
: No...I’m okay. Just a little tired.
lines.zh: ：不……我没事。就是有点累。

lines.en: : You sure?
lines.zh: ：真的？

lines.en: : I know we’re not really the closest, but I’ve still known ya since all the way back in first grade.
lines.zh: ：我知道我们算不上最亲近的，不过我从一年级就认识你了。

lines.en: : Us short girls gotta stick together, ya know?
lines.zh: ：我们这种矮个子女生得抱团，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Not just for when we’re feelin’ sad and stuff, but for when we’ve gotta reach things that normal girls can reach.
lines.zh: ：不只是难过的时候，还有要够到那些正常身高的女生够得到的东西的时候。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay25
: Heheh...
lines.zh: ：嘿嘿……

lines.en: : I guess we would make a...good team if we ever needed to...do something like that.
lines.zh: ：我觉得如果真要……做那种事的话，我们会是……不错的搭档。

lines.en: : Well, if there’s anythin’ I’m good at, it’s bein’ part of a team.
lines.zh: ：嗯，要说我擅长什么，那就是当团队里的一员。

lines.en: : Hey, you don’t have any interest in playin’ soccer, do you? Cause we could use another tiny girl or two.
lines.zh: ：嘿，你有兴趣踢足球吗？我们还能再招一两个小个子女生。

lines.en: : Work out those legs of yours and you’ll be the next Usain Bolt before ya even know it.
lines.zh: ：把你那双腿练一练，不知不觉你就成下一个博尔特了。

lines.en: : I...don’t know who that is...but I’m not really interested in soccer...
lines.zh: ：我……不知道那是谁……不过我对足球没什么兴趣……

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay26
: If you...um...
lines.zh: ：如果你……嗯……

lines.en: : If you ever want to...play video games or something, though...
lines.zh: ：不过要是你哪天想……一起打游戏什么的……

lines.en: : Heck yeah! I haven’t played games in like six trillion years cause Makoto’s always callin’ em poison for the mind.
lines.zh: ：那当然！我大概有六万亿年没打过游戏了，因为 Makoto 老说那是精神毒药。

lines.en: : That and the fact that I should...probably be usin’ my free time to study.
lines.zh: ：还有一点就是，我……大概该把空闲时间拿来学习。

lines.en: : Studying is boring, though...
lines.zh: ：不过学习很无聊啊……

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay27
: Ya got that right.
lines.zh: ：你说得对。

lines.en: : ‘Sides...it’s not like we’ve got a teacher that really cares about that anymore anyway.
lines.zh: ：再说了……反正我们也不再有个真正关心这个的老师了。

lines.en: : ‘Two of us could probably ditch[school] for a week straight and come back with straight A’s if Makoto wasn’t there to bust into our rooms and spank us for bein’ absent.
lines.zh: ：要不是 Makoto 会冲进我们房间、因为我们旷课而打我们屁股，我们俩大概能连着逃一星期[school]，回来还门门满分。

lines.en: : Just kiddin’. Makoto’s never spanked me.
lines.zh: ：开玩笑的。Makoto 从没打过我屁股。

lines.en: : But I’ve also never missed[school] for more than a day, so...
lines.zh: ：不过我也从没旷过超过一天的[school]，所以……

lines.en: : Hey, if you wanna chime in, feel free. If not, I’ll probably just keep ramblin’ on about a bunch of random stuff until the sun goes down.
lines.zh: ：嘿，你要想插嘴尽管插。不想的话，我大概就会一直胡扯些有的没的，扯到太阳下山。

lines.en: : Heheh...no, it’s fine...
lines.zh: ：嘿嘿……不，挺好的……

lines.en: : It’s easier for me when other people talk anyway...
lines.zh: ：反正别人说话的时候我更轻松……

lines.en: : Sounds good to me.
lines.zh: ：我没意见。

lines.en: : I was kinda here not too long ago anyway, so this whole beach trip thing is probably a little less excitin’ for me than it is for you and everybody you came with.
lines.zh: ：反正我不久前才来过，所以这趟海滩旅行对我来说，大概没你和跟你一起来的人那么新鲜。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay28
: You were here recently?
lines.zh: ：你最近来过？

lines.en: : Mhm! With Makoto and Sensei.
lines.zh: ：嗯！和 Makoto 还有 Sensei 一起。

lines.en: : Pretty sure I’m allowed to tell you about that. I don’t think it was meant to be a secret or anythin’.
lines.zh: ：我挺确定这事可以跟你说的。我不觉得这是什么秘密之类的。

lines.en: : But if it was, you didn’t hear it from me.
lines.zh: ：不过要是是秘密，那你就当没从我这儿听过。

lines.en: : Sensei was...there as well?
lines.zh: ：Sensei 也……也在？

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay29
: Yup! Think it was somethin’ Makoto wanted to do to make sure we had enough room for this trip or whatever.
lines.zh: ：是啊！好像是 Makoto 想确认我们这趟旅行房间够不够之类的。

lines.en: : Can’t actually remember the reason, but I {i}do{/i} remember the three of us were there and it was...
lines.zh: ：具体原因我记不清了，但我记得我们三个当时在那儿，那{i}是{/i}……

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay30
: It was...
lines.zh: ：那是……

lines.en: : Fun...
lines.zh: ：很开心……

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay31
Two girls in a line on the beach.
lines.zh: 两个女生在海滩上排成一条线。

lines.en: Seen an undisclosed amount of time before breaking.
lines.zh: 在那条线断开之前，它被看见了不知多久。

lines.en: Could it be tomorrow?
lines.zh: 会是明天吗？

lines.en: The next day?
lines.zh: 第二天？

lines.en: The day after that?
lines.zh: 再往后一天？

lines.en: A month from now?
lines.zh: 一个月后？

lines.en: A year?
lines.zh: 一年后？

lines.en: Or perhaps the two of them are already broken.
lines.zh: 又或许她们两个早就已经断了。

lines.en: And perhaps they’re not just staring off into the distance right now, but searching the shoreline for the remnants of things they may have lost.
lines.zh: 又或许她们此刻并非只是望着远方发呆，而是在海岸线上搜寻那些她们可能遗失之物的残骸。

lines.en: Everyone loses something, you know.
lines.zh: 每个人都会失去些什么，你知道的。

lines.en: I bet you’ve lost a fair deal yourself.
lines.zh: 我敢说你自己也丢过不少。

lines.en: But how would you compare it to them?
lines.zh: 可你要拿它跟她们的比吗？

lines.en: And {i}should{/i} you compare it in the first place?
lines.zh: 而且你一开始就{i}该{/i}比较吗？

lines.en: Two girls in a line on the beach, measuring around the same size as a professional basketball hoop when their heights are combined.
lines.zh: 两个女生在海滩上排成一条线，身高加起来差不多有一个职业篮球筐那么高。

lines.en: But the lack of physical verticality and concealed desire to snatch away the object of their respective best friends’ affection is not the only similarity they share.
lines.zh: 但身高上的欠缺、以及想把各自最好朋友所爱之人抢走的隐秘欲望，并不是她们唯一的共同点。

lines.en: They share a bond much deeper-
lines.zh: 她们之间还有一条更深得多的纽带——

lines.en: One that very few will understand.
lines.zh: 一条极少有人能理解的纽带。

lines.en: One that very few {i}want{/i} to understand.
lines.zh: 一条极少有人{i}想{/i}去理解的纽带。

lines.en: I will tell you now that they {i}were{/i} looking for the remnants of things they once lost in the sand.
lines.zh: 现在我来告诉你们：她们在沙子里寻找的，是曾经遗失之物的残骸。

lines.en: Neither of them expected to find anything, of course.
lines.zh: 当然，她们谁也没指望能找到什么。

lines.en: I mean, why would they?
lines.zh: 我是说，她们凭什么指望呢？

lines.en: But I, just as they do, struggle to think that anyone can walk around a place like this without incessantly gazing down at their feet in hopes of finding something that takes them back.
lines.zh: 但我和她们一样，很难相信有人能走在这样的地方，却不一刻不停地低头盯着自己的脚，盼着找到某样把自己带回去的东西。

lines.en: A seashell.
lines.zh: 一枚贝壳。

lines.en: A coin with a specific year on it.
lines.zh: 一枚刻着特定年份的硬币。

lines.en: The sunglasses of a woman who was pulled in by the current.
lines.zh: 一副被卷进海流里的女人的太阳镜。

lines.en: Mementos and mementos and mementos!
lines.zh: 纪念品、纪念品、还是纪念品！

lines.en: Each one left behind with a story of its own.
lines.zh: 每一件被留下时，都带着属于自己的故事。

lines.en: Every object in every place is more than it seems.
lines.zh: 每个地方的每件物品，都不只是它看起来的样子。

lines.en: Just like every downtrodden, longing stare from a girl with A-cups is also more than it seems.
lines.zh: 就像每一个 A 杯女孩那被压低的、充满渴望的目光，也都不只是看起来的样子。

lines.en: They connect.
lines.zh: 它们是相连的。

lines.en: : Hey...
: How do you...feel about Sensei?
lines.zh: ：你……觉得 Sensei 怎么样？

lines.en: : Not...as a teacher, but-
lines.zh: ：不是……作为老师，而是——

lines.en: : I want him to be with Makoto.
lines.zh: ：我想让他和 Makoto 在一起。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay32
: With...Makoto?
lines.zh: ：和……Makoto？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: She’s liked him from the moment she met him.
lines.zh: ：从见到他的那一刻起她就喜欢他了。

lines.en: : And she’s my best friend, so I have to root for her.
lines.zh: ：而且她是我最好的朋友，所以我必须支持她。

lines.en: : Makoto works harder than anybody and doesn’t have much to show for it other than good grades.
lines.zh: ：Makoto 比谁都努力，可除了好成绩之外，她也没什么能拿出来给人看的。

lines.en: : Her dad was a big part of her life, too...and now he’s up in space. So all she’s really got in terms of a guy figure to look up to is Sensei.
lines.zh: ：她爸爸也曾是她生命里很重要的一部分……可现在他在太空里。所以说到能让她仰望的男性形象，她基本上只剩 Sensei 了。

lines.en: : So I want him to look at her the same way she looks at him.
lines.zh: ：所以我想让他用她看他的那种眼神去看她。

lines.en: : That way, everyone can be happy.
lines.zh: ：那样的话，大家就都能幸福了。

lines.en: : Yeah.
: I want him to end up with Makoto.
lines.zh: ：我想让他最后和 Makoto 在一起。

lines.en: scene beachpartyyay33
: I don’t want him to end up with anybody.
lines.zh: ：我不想让他最后和任何人在一起。

lines.en: : I guess that would be the next best thing for me too.
lines.zh: ：我想对我来说，那也是退而求其次了。

lines.en: scene black
The line remains unmoving on the beach, blending in with thousands more left there by nature or the pointy end of a stick gripped firmly by the slimy fingers of someone’s child.
lines.zh: 那条线在海滩上一动不动，与大自然、或与某个孩子黏糊糊的手指紧握的树枝尖端所留下的成千上万条线融为一体。

lines.en: Neither girl ever finds anything they’re looking for.
lines.zh: 两个女孩都没能找到她们在找的东西。

lines.en: But, on the bright side-
lines.zh: 不过，往好处想——

lines.en: All of the other girls seem to have a good time.
lines.zh: 其他所有女生看起来都玩得很开心。

lines.zh: {i}有东西埋在你脚下！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Could it be here?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}会在这儿吗？{/i}
